title: Hearty Crispy Tunisian Minced Beef Kebabs
description: A flavorful and adventurous Tunisian dish featuring minced beef, with a mustardy and crispy twist, perfect for a dinner meal, and is fodmap friendly.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the minced beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, whole-grain mustard, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Mix everything together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Flatten each ball slightly into a pattie shape.
Brush the yakimono grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and crispy on the outside.
Serve the kebabs hot with your favorite sides.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
